paths.name: @phosphor-icons/react
paths.message: The package barrel builds a React element for all ~3000 icons at module scope - it cost 383ms of startup before this rule existed. Import the one icon instead: `@phosphor-icons/react/dist/icons/Plus` (exports `PlusIcon`), `dist/lib/context` for `IconContext`, `dist/lib/types` for the `Icon` type.

patterns.message: Engine must not import from the game or editor layers (README dependency rule).
Editor must not import from the game layer (README dependency rule).
